verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a shareable, no-code payment link created from the Paddle dashboard. The checkout options shown (Paddle.js, inline, overlay) all require some frontend code. Dashboard-created transactions and sales-assisted invoices are related features, but neither is documented as a shareable payment link, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately
